title: attract magnet signal never fires when the upgraded pipe is not the lowest-slot member of a parallel bundle
detail: Hop.pipe is the bundle's lowest-slot representative (routing.odin:259-260), and validate_draw allows parallel pipes between the same pair. Upgrading a non-representative parallel member genuinely re-prices the edge (min-cost bundle) yet attract stays false — the 'attracts N flows' telegraph silently under-reports.
recommended_fix: Set attract when any live pipe sharing the hop's (from,neighbor) pair is the upgraded pipe, not only on rep-id equality — scan the pair's pipes in forecast_shift.

title: The preview's commit leg is unwalkable in the app — no demolish input exists, so the Verify loop cannot be performed
detail: handle_input binds only U/1/2/E/S/B — no Cmd_Demolish_Pipe input anywhere in app/main.odin. The spec's Verify requires the player to demolish+redraw to commit the predicted upgrade; in the shipped app that action is unavailable, so the prediction can never be confirmed live.
recommended_fix: Add a demolish input (or other commit binding) to handle_input so the U-preview → commit → verify loop is walkable in the app, or explicitly descope the in-app commit to a follow-up job.

title: The upgrade-preview render branch (preview != nil) has zero automated coverage — harness always passes nil
detail: The only T2 capture call site omits preview (default nil), and forecast_shift.dem never arms a preview (no U in demos). Every branch of draw_upgrade_preview — rows, magnet line, overflow tail, 'no reroute predicted', from/to ids — is untested by golden or unit test.
recommended_fix: Add a harness path that builds a preview (or a render-level test driving draw_upgrade_preview) with a golden pinning the card, including the overflow and zero-shift branches.

title: routing_rebuild_with_tiers indexes the caller-supplied tier view without any length validation
detail: The new public seam accepts an arbitrary tiers slice and indexes tiers[pi] for pi up to len(pipe_alive)-1. Both current callers pass matching lengths, so no live panic — but a future hypothetical view shorter than pipe_alive hits an out-of-bounds index with no guard.
recommended_fix: Guard the seam: if len(tiers) < len(t.pipe_alive) return (or assert) before the Dijkstra loops, making the tier-view contract explicit.
